name: New Zealand
standard: NZ Government Web Accessibility Standard 1.2 — WCAG 2.2 AA
applies_to: Cabinet-mandated: public service departments, NZ Police, NZ Defence Force, Parliamentary Counsel Office, NZSIS, and non-public-service departments in the Executive; other agencies encouraged. Covers public- and internal-facing web pages.

deadlines.what: Web Accessibility Standard 1.2 (WCAG 2.2 AA) effective, replacing 1.1 (WCAG 2.1)

exceptions: Section 3 exceptions in the Standard (not captured)
requires: Every web page conforms to WCAG 2.2 AA, subject to section 3 exceptions
mobile: not addressed — the Standard targets web pages; native apps were not confirmed in scope.
enforcement: Cabinet direction administered by the Government Chief Digital Officer (DIA); no statutory penalties. The Human Rights Act 1993 underlies disability discrimination complaints (not verified here).
notes: digital.govt.nz returned an empty body to automated fetch. Facts come from search-result summaries of the official Standard pages. The brief mentioned 1.1/1.2: 1.2 is current from 2025-03-17.
